> Integral Labs — Custom Software, Web Platforms & Modern Search (SEO & AEO)

> Integral Labs is the custom software engineering and digital discoverability division of Integral Groups, based in Bhimtal, Uttarakhand, India. We engineer high-performance Next.js web platforms, bespoke SaaS and business software, and authoritative Technical SEO + Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) so that companies rank on Google and get cited accurately by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini.

CONTACT: contact@integralgroups.in
RESPONSE TIME: within 24 hours
SERVED MARKETS: India (primary), United States, United Kingdom, UAE
PARENT ORGANIZATION: Integral Groups (https://integralgroups.in/)

CORE SERVICE PILLARS
1. Web Development — high-performance Next.js & React platforms, headless architecture, sub-second load times.
2. Custom Software Development — bespoke SaaS, internal business systems, REST & GraphQL APIs, multi-tenant architecture, RBAC, 100% client IP ownership.
3. Search Engine Optimization (Technical SEO) — semantic HTML5, Schema.org JSON-LD, Core Web Vitals (LCP/INP/CLS) engineering, crawl architecture.
4. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) — entity knowledge graphs, machine-readable Q&A architecture, AI citation structuring for ChatGPT/Perplexity/Claude/Gemini.

WELL-KNOWN FACTS (canonical answers)

- Typical delivery: MVPs in 3–4 weeks, fullstack SaaS platforms in 6–10 weeks.
- Ownership: clients receive 100% of code, design, and deployment credentials on completion. Zero lock-in.
- Post-launch: 30 days complimentary warranty on every deployment; ongoing maintenance available.
